entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, earth, cocoa, coffee, cedar and dark-fruit sweetness give Antaño 1970 a dense, forceful Nicaraguan profile. The ligero-heavy puro brings substantial nicotine and a dry pepper backbone, while cocoa, coffee and black-cherry sweetness add enough depth to keep the strength from becoming one-dimensional. The 4″ × 32 format should make this one of the hardest-hitting quick smokes in the catalogue.
